channel.title: Maple's Recipe Test Feed
channel.description: A few Blue Apron and Home Chef recipes to test Mela feed import.

item.title: Seared Chicken & Lemon Labneh over Spicy Squash Farro (Blue Apron)
item.description: Seared chicken over spiced farro with roasted squash, currants, and roasted red peppers, finished with lemon labneh and a honey-chile dressing. (Blue Apron)

item.title: Beef Meatballs in Creamy Onion Gravy (Home Chef)
item.description: Beef meatballs with Dijon in a creamy onion gravy, served over mashed potatoes with baby spinach. (Home Chef)

item.title: Sesame-Panko Crusted Chicken with Roasted Broccoli, Potatoes & Yuzu Mayo (Blue Apron)
item.description: Oven-roasted chicken breasts under a sesame-panko crust with yuzu mayo, alongside sesame-roasted broccoli, potatoes, and red onion. (Blue Apron)

item.title: Snappy Steak & Guacamole Taco (Home Chef)
item.description: Steak tacos with guacamole, cheddar-jack, crispy jalapenos, and baby arugula. (Home Chef)

item.title: Sheet Pan Fig-Dijon Chicken Thighs with Roasted Potatoes, Peppers & Goat Cheese (Blue Apron)
item.description: Chicken thighs glazed with fig spread, Dijon, and thyme, roasted on one sheet pan with potatoes, peppers, and red onion, finished with goat cheese. (Blue Apron)

item.title: Mojito Lime Chicken Salad (Home Chef)
item.description: Romaine salad with mojito-lime seasoned chicken, roasted red peppers, tortilla strips, and chipotle ranch dressing. (Home Chef)
